items.html: And below it there is the aspect of the Hochma of AA, called in the Idra the Mocha Stima'ah of Atik. And that upper brain in the Keter of AA, called by the name air, although in relation to the Keter itself it is called the brain within it, nevertheless it becomes a real skull in relation to the Hochma of AA, which is the Mocha Stima'ah of AA. And therefore also that upper brain, called the air, is also called a real head in relation to the Hochma, the Mocha Stima'ah of AA.
